Flawless Wellness SPA

Flawless Wellness Spa takes pride in our well-rounded services. We want you to look and feel better about yourself as soon as you step through our doors. When you come to our spa, you can:
.
  • Get pampered with basic spa services, like facials, massages, and waxing
  • Check out our advanced medical spa, for wellness advice and treatments
  • Visit our tea or oxygen bar, to warm your body and revitalize your cells
  • Relax on our outdoor patio, complete with fire pits and hammock chairs

We offer a variety of spa and wellness services, so you can relax and revitalize your body.

Body Harmony Day Spa

Body Harmony Day Spa provides a very unique 90-minute Sensory Therapeutic bodywork. The Body Harmony Session experience features the Body Harmony Instrument Bed with 9 to 12 inches of memory foam for comfort and ultimate relaxation. This special bed is handcrafted like a musical instrument with speakers on the inside. While surround sound fills the room, musical vibrations from inside the bed resonate in and through the body. The body’s holistic response is at cellular level.
Each session includes a mineral-rich Dead Sea mud facial mask, a deep massage of the head and scalp with warm, melted Shea Butter, and the use of hot steam towels for absorption. Pure, warm African Shea Butter is drizzled-bathed and massaged into the body. Next, 100% Dead Sea salts are sprinkled slowly on the body and gently scrubbed for exfoliation. Hot, moist and steamy towels are wrapped around the body and the salts are melted, allowing 90% of trace minerals to be absorbed. Soothing back massage or firm is your preference.
